how: Each body was served over plain HTTP from a local server, with the Content-Type given (none when null), and opened at the top level in a fresh profile with --dump-dom. word is the bytes a word in the body was written in. chrome_text is that word as Chrome decoded it: for HTML the textContent of #t, which a script in the page wrote into the title with document.characterSet, given as chrome_encoding; for other documents the decoding of the word found in the dumped DOM; null when the word was nowhere in it.
